title: Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Junior Research Fellow(s)
text:
KEY LINES:
ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:
to be send by post or email at dropkatareuips@gmail.com by 25.05.2026

FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Junior Research
Fellow(s) to work on various NDDS level drug delivery systems for clinical
applications in the Alaina Healthcare project sanctioned to undersigned.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for a interview through telephone/email in
the office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh. No TA/DA will
be paid if called for an interview.
ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:
• M. Pharm/M.S. (Pharmaceutics/Industrial Pharmacy or any other
equivalent discipline).
• Minimum of 55% marks at Graduate and Master’s levels both (50% in case
of SC/ST/PH)
• Qualified in GPAT, GATE, UGC-NET or PU PhD entrance exam.
Fellowship:
• Monthly emoluments of Rs. 20,000/- p.m.
Sd/- Sd/-
Dr Amita Sarwal
Principal Investigator
Prof Anil Kumar
Chairperson, UIPS
Scanned copies of all the educational degrees, experience and Curriculum vitae is
to be send by post or email at dropkatareuips@gmail.com by 25.05.2026
Note: The selected candidate can be offered Ph.D. registration under the project.
